parameters.name: Category
parameters.description:
The snapshot type. Valid values:
- Standard: Normal snapshot.
- Flash: local snapshot. This value is about to be deprecated. Local snapshots have been replaced by the snapshot instant access feature. The metric description is as follows:
  - If you used local snapshots before December 14, 2020, you can use this parameter as it is active.
  - If you did not use local snapshots before December 14, 2020, you cannot use this parameter.
- archive: archive snapshot.



<props="china">For more information, see [Chinese notice on Alibaba Cloud snapshot service upgrade and new billing items on December 14](https://help.aliyun.com/noticelist/articleid/1060755542.html).</props>

parameters.name: DiskId
parameters.description: The ID of the disk.

parameters.name: DryRun
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run. Valid values:

- true: performs only a dry run. The system checks the request for potential issues, including invalid AccessKey pairs, unauthorized RAM users, and missing parameter values. If the request fails the dry run, an error message is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the DryRunOperation error code is returned.
- false (default): performs a dry run and sends the request. If the request passes the dry run, a 2XX HTTP status code is returned and the resource status is queried.

parameters.name: Encrypted
parameters.description: Specifies whether to filter encrypted snapshots. Default value: false.

parameters.name: Filter.1.Key
parameters.description: The filter key used to query resources. Set the value to `CreationStartTime`. When you specify both `Filter.1.Key` and `Filter.1.Value`, you can query resources created after the specified point in time.

parameters.name: Filter.1.Value
parameters.description: The filter value used to query resources. When you specify this parameter, you must also specify `Filter.1.Key`. Specify the time in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ` format in UTC.

parameters.name: Filter.2.Key
parameters.description: The filter key used to query resources. Set the value to `CreationEndTime`. When you specify both `Filter.2.Key` and `Filter.2.Value`, you can query resources created before the specified point in time.

parameters.name: Filter.2.Value
parameters.description: The filter value used to query resources. When you specify this parameter, you must also specify `Filter.2.Key`. Specify the time in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ` format in UTC.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. Specify this parameter to query snapshot information of disks attached to the instance.

parameters.name: KMSKeyId
parameters.description: The Key Management Service (KMS) key ID for the data disk.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description:
The maximum number of entries per page for paging query. Maximum value: 100.

Default value: 10.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token. Obtained from the response of the previous request.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: > This parameter is about to be deprecated. Use NextToken and MaxResults to complete paging query operations.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: > This parameter is about to be deprecated. Use NextToken and MaxResults to complete paging query operations.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the disk. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description:
The resource group ID. When you use this parameter to filter resources, the resource count cannot exceed 1000.

> Filtering by default resource group is not supported.

parameters.name: SnapshotIds
parameters.description: The snapshot IDs. The value is a JSON array that consists of up to 100 snapshot IDs. Separate the IDs with commas (,).

parameters.name: SnapshotLinkId
parameters.description: The snapshot chain ID.

parameters.name: SnapshotName
parameters.description: The snapshot name.

parameters.name: SnapshotType
parameters.description:
The automatic creation type. Valid values: 
         
- auto: automatic snapshot.
- user: manual snapshot.
- all (default): all automatic creation types.

parameters.name: SourceDiskType
parameters.description:
The type of the source disk. Valid values: 
     
- system: system disk.
- data: data disk.

> The values are case-insensitive.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The snapshot status. Valid values: 
         
- progressing: The snapshot is being created.
- accomplished: The snapshot is created.
- failed: The snapshot failed to be created.
- all (default): all snapshot statuses.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The tag key of the snapshot. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

If you use a single tag to filter resources, the resource count with the tag cannot exceed 1000. If you use multiple tags to filter resources, the resource count with all the specified tags attached cannot exceed 1000. If the resource count exceeds 1000, call the [ListTagResources](~~110425~~) operation.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The tag value of the snapshot. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

sub_parameters.name: key
sub_parameters.description:
The tag key of the resource.

> For better compatibility, use Tag.N.Key instead.

sub_parameters.name: value
sub_parameters.description:
The tag value of the resource.

> For better compatibility, use Tag.N.Value instead.

parameters.name: Usage
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the snapshot has been used to create images or disks. Valid values: 

- image: The snapshot has been used to create custom images.
- disk: The snapshot has been used to create disks.
- image_disk: The snapshot has been used to create both data disks and custom images.
- none: The snapshot has not been used.
